Author: Gautam Chowdhary
Bench: Gautam Chowdhary
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Cancellation Application No. - 163 of 2024
Applicant :- Saumya Singh

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashwaini Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Dr. Gautam Chowdhary,J. 
1.

Heard learned counsel for the informant-applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the
record.

2. The instant anticipatory bail cancellation application has been moved on behalf of the informant
for cancelling the bail granted to the accused-opposite party no.2 in Case Crime No.337 of 2023
under Sections 419, 420, 406, 504, 506, 120-B I.P.C., Police Station Cantt., District Varanasi.

3.  Learned counsel for the applicant-informant submits that the accused-opposite party no.2 was granted anticipatory bail subject to the conditions contained in the bail order, however, the accused-opposite party no.2 after released on anticipatory bail started making pressure and giving threatening to the applicant to compromise the matter.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. submits that the informant has a remedy available under the Witness Protection Scheme Scheme, 2018 and thus the instant bail cancellation application may be disposed of in the light of protection granted to the witnesses under the Witness Protection Scheme, 2018.

5. In view of the submissions made by learned A.G.A., this Court is of the opinion, that the applicant has remedy available to him under Witness Protection Scheme, 2018, which scheme has been approved by Hon?ble Apex Court in Mahender Chawla and others Vs. Union of India reported in (2019) 14 SCC 615.
6.

entities.text: Mahender Chawla and others Vs. Union of India reported in (2019) 14 SCC 615
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, present bail cancellation application is disposed of with a direction, in case, the informant-applicant moves appropriate application on the proforma prescribed in the Witness Protection Scheme 2018 alongwith a certified copy of this order for redressal of his grievances, as raised in the instant bail cancellation application, before the competent authority as has been defined under Section 2 (c) of the Witness Protection Scheme, 2018 within a week from today, same shall be considered and decided as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of one month from date of filing such application, strictly in accordance with the Witness Protection Scheme 2018.

Order Date :- 10.7.2025 S.Ali  Saumya Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/23204921/
